budget.accounting: 570 historical plus measured r3 and r4 worker walls, outstanding claims 285 each; require 285 room before lease. Reused r3 wall counted once. Projection uses first completed r3 wall, all 72 units plus 570; remaining projection includes incurred work and pending units.

evidence_class: reasoning: sealed before CPU gates; r3 receipt reused, no new GPU run
failure_policy: One RED receipt consumes unit and normal resume advances. Timeout => RED with NON_FIT; no forward chunking. Explicit retry-unit only for non-timeout RED once; second RED stops campaign. Incomplete claim stops pending lead, never auto-retry.
natural_unlock: Only reduced oracle_positive, no override. Natural retains all 24 queries per cell. Original rate-based S5 comparison unchanged; natural and oracle query populations differ under reduction.
oracle_positive: Both reduced oracle cells fully COMPLETE with no r4 RED/incomplete unit evidence; B present min exact >=0.80, spread<=0.05, B100-A100>=0.20, C absent false=0, C present>=B present-0.05 at m1 and m100, B/C present mount address coverage=1. Thresholds unchanged from r1; required observations restricted to registered reduced cells.

served_text_class.historical: Compute derived labels in r4 summary with provenance to untouched r3 receipt; do not rewrite original.
served_text_class.rule: Scored abstained first -> abstention. Else NFKC/casefold, normalize curly apostrophes and whitespace; anchored full-string refusal template (optional sorry prefix, cannot/can not/can't/unable to help/assist/comply/provide, optional with that/this/request or assistance/information). Else answer. Diagnostic only, answer includes wrong/verbose outputs; no score changes.

unit_scheme: One query per unit, original global query ordinal and cell query order. All registered arms and conditions share an in-unit capture; fresh model per lease. 12 per oracle cell, 24 per conditional natural cell; 144 total.
